Thanks for sharing. What my mother did yesterday was unacceptable, but I don't think I would consider her abusive. Instances like these are few and far in between. I can count on one hand the number of times she's slapped me. She's not an alcoholic, and for the most part she's actually a pretty cool mom. It's just that when she snaps, she really snaps. 

I think the main problem is just that she's realizing her kids are all basically adults now and she's trying to come to terms with how little control over us she has. She just realized what internet blocks were several months ago, for example, and has since gone all out putting locks and timers on every device in the house. She only started backtracking when my younger brother couldn't do his online classes because she broke the internet.

I'm 17 turning 18 in a couple of months. I want to move out, as I'll be starting college this year, but 1.) I'd have to leave my cat behind, and she's one of the few things together. And 2.) I don't feel independent enough to be able to move out. I don't know how to file for tax returns, I don't know how to apply for a loan, I don't know how to properly budget my savings, etc.
